name: Burdine Hall

sources.dimensions: South wall and roof edges measured by ray-plane intersections from a fitted reference-photograph camera; main roof anchored to the 19.9 m USGS lidar top. Hidden north outline retained.
sources.observations: Five segmental arched bays on one straight projecting entrance face; right volume projects farther and is grounded. Full-height lowest main windows are partly hidden by the entrance roof. Upper surrounds, relief, door distinction and compact materials retained.

_heights_src.main: 19.68 m final: USGS 19.9 m provided the roof anchor. Fixed-camera ray-plane fit initially gave 19.81-19.90 m. The second rendered roof edge was about 10 pixels above the reference photograph's roof edge near the left and 2-3 pixels above at the far end; lowering the roof and south openings 0.22 m removes this residual. No height was set from a storey count.
_heights_src.entrance: Arcade refitted on the close reference photograph's camera rays at the estimated deeper plane; thresholds grounded.
_heights_src.east_end: Ground-supported right volume beyond fifth arch; height inherited as an estimate, not newly measured.
_heights_src.north: 12.8 m retained from starter where neither supplied view exposes the roof.
_heights_src.mechanical: USGS maximum 26.4 m includes machinery; machinery position and form unobserved, so no arbitrary rooftop box added.
_heights_src.retained_floor_grid: The global floor grid remains the starter grid solely for unphotographed generic elevations. Every observed south opening has explicit measured elevations independent of that grid.

open: Entrance and right-block depths are set from what the reference photographs show; no exact unseen depth is claimed. Hidden north geometry remains inherited.
